api_doc_gaps.detail: Error Catalog (SECTION A) maps auth ERR-IDs to HTTP 401 (ERR-0011 invalid credentials, ERR-0005 refresh), 403 (ERR-0008 non-active), 423 (ERR-0004 locked), 400 (ERR-0006/0007 reset/activation token) and 422 (ERR-0003 complexity). The shared common.domain.status.Status enum (frozen — common/ is out of scope for this sub) has no 401/403/423 constant, and the already-built SEC Domain objects throw BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION (422) for non-active/locked/refresh/reset/activation and VALIDATION_ERROR (400) for complexity. Closest available mappings were used without inventing statuses: invalid-credentials/non-active/locked/refresh/reset/activation -> 422; complexity -> 400. Exact ERR->HTTP fidelity requires extending Status (add UNAUTHORIZED 401, FORBIDDEN 403, LOCKED 423) or adjusting the DATA-DOM Domain throw statuses — both outside SVC-API-AUTH scope.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: ESCALATED TO USER (2026-09-04). Root cause: authoritative Error Catalog demands 401/403/423 but the shared common.domain.status.Status enum is a deliberately frozen 8-value foundation contract (CLAUDE.md STRUCTURAL LAW; CORE.md) and DATA-DOM domain objects already throw BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION(422)/VALIDATION_ERROR(400). Project convention (DRV-008) maps business errors onto existing enum statuses, so the implemented 422/400 mapping is internally consistent. Exact fidelity requires extending common/Status (add UNAUTHORIZED 401/FORBIDDEN 403/LOCKED 423) + repointing the DATA-DOM domain throws — a shared-foundation structural change requiring explicit human sign-off, NOT done autonomously. Module execution continued; later subs reuse the same enum consistently. Awaiting user decision on whether to make the foundation change.
